blurb: Turn from the light: the fallen rise again at your call, and every heresy you commit makes them stronger, and you hungrier.
name: Devil Forgemaster
notes: Built on Divine Favor: raising the dead spends Favor, and Favor can go below zero as Heresy stacks. Positive Favor is the base passive's damage bonus; negative Favor (Heresy) powers your summons and risks a flesh-eating lunge.
